Features.heading: Everything you need to reimagine a room

Features.f2Description: From Scandinavian to Japanese to Art Deco — swap styles instantly to see what fits before committing.

Pricing.heading: Simple pricing, pay once

Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.q1question: Do I need to create an account?
Faq.q1answer: You can upload a photo and pick a style without one — creating a free account is only needed to reveal and download your redesign.
Faq.q2question: Will it change the structure of my room?
Faq.q2answer: No. Walls, windows, and the room's layout stay exactly where they are — only furniture, decor, and finishes change.
Faq.q3answer: A well-lit, straight-on photo of the room works best. JPEG, PNG, and WebP are all supported.
Faq.q4question: How long does a redesign take?
Faq.q4answer: Usually under a minute from upload to result.
Faq.q5question: Can I ask for something specific, like a color or a piece of furniture?
Faq.q5answer: Yes — after picking a room type and style, there's a free-text field to describe any tweak you want included.
Faq.q6answer: Every account gets 2 free tokens (1 token = 1 redesign or 1 edit) with limited styles and a watermark on downloads — no card required. Beyond that, buy a one-time pack ($5 for 10 tokens, $12 for 25, or $20 for 50) to unlock every design style and watermark-free downloads. Packs stack and tokens never expire.
Faq.q7answer: Your photos are used only to generate your redesign.
